Upper corridor (room-10) furnished: a red_carpet runner along the one-cell landing (x 9..18, z 13) and two hanging lanterns at x 13 and x 16, y 22 under the loft floor.

Lanes and door heads stay clear; no furniture on the floor, since the landing is one cell wide.
left: Plan grid shows the hall doorway at x 8 but joinery places the door at x 9 z 13 (inside the box); the carpet there is refused, which is harmless, but plan.md's door coordinate should be reconciled.
